exposure: Previous abdominal surgery for urinary or bowel management
Folic acid consumption prior to pregnancy
outcome: Mobility changes during and after pregnancy
Bladder and bowel management changes during and after pregnancy
cohort: The study included 6 women with spina bifida who successfully carried 8 pregnancies to term and were followed in an adult multidisciplinary SB clinic.
finding: Over half of the women experienced new changes to mobility, bladder, and bowel management during their pregnancies, which generally returned to baseline afterwards, and no children were born with neural tube defects.
mod_finding: 50% of the women had a spontaneous vaginal delivery.
